# Eatbook.sg

> > Singapore's leading local food guide featuring hawker reviews, restaurant coverage, and authentic Singapore dining experiences.

Eatbook.sg is a comprehensive Singapore food review site covering everything from budget hawker stalls and kopitiam favorites to fine dining restaurants and chef interviews. The site specializes in discovering affordable local eats, limited-edition food products, and hidden gems across Singapore's diverse food landscape.

## Key Topics

- Singapore hawker food
- Budget eats under $10
- Local food guides
- Hawker centre reviews
- Restaurant reviews
- Chef interviews
- Limited-edition food products
- Affordable dining
- Singapore street food
- Fine dining
- Local flavours
- Food news Singapore
- Chinatown food
- Western food Singapore
- Traditional desserts

- [UBI 350 Crispy Prata: Must-Try Super Crispy Prata For Only $0.80](https://eatbook.sg/ubi-350): Review of UBI 350 Crispy Prata's $0.80 super crispy prata in Ubi
- [115 Tang Shui Review: Beautiful Stone-Ground Traditional Chinese Desserts Under $2 In Chinatown](https://eatbook.sg/115-tang-shui): Review of 115 Tang Shui's traditional Chinese desserts in Chinatown
